rationale.automation-bias: Review induces deference to AI expertise and significantly less human revision.
rationale.oversight-theater: Outcome-only review paradoxically worsens engagement because reviewers lack process information.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Showing original and final outputs gives reviewers process-level visibility.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Process disclosure and AI interaction logs make human contributions traceable.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes the prevailing assumption that review strengthens accountability and engagement.
rationale.general-ai: Studies general knowledge-work content rather than AI-generated code.
rationale.non-developer: Participants were students, panelists, and teachers, not professional developers.
rationale.agentic: Prompted AI delivered complete artifacts for whole-output review and revision.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Experiments measure passive acceptance and minimal modification of AI output.
rationale.method-experiment: Seven controlled experiments manipulated review and process-transparency conditions.
